text: ok great back to this tab surface, i do not ideally want the world to say world. it can just be a globe icon, and then there after, you need to ensure that this doesnt happen. look here already, this has a huge amount of dead space. not acceptable. [Image #1]
resolution: Adjusted the editor stage document tab surface so the world document no longer renders the text-heavy World Editor/main.gamefile tab. The world document is now an icon-only globe tab, and regular document tabs use bounded compact sizing instead of the previous oversized active/inactive fixed widths, eliminating the dead space shown in the tab strip.
